instructions: Port the driver from origin/spike/orchestration-arms:spike/arms/ (measure.mjs, analyse.mjs, arm-faberun.mjs, arm-session.mjs, contract.mjs, corpus.mjs, fork.mjs, lib.mjs, prompt.mjs, checks/) into evals/paired/ as modules of this tree, and wire `--class paired` in evals/run.mjs through a module of its own.
